children: European stocks closed higher on Wednesday, halting sharp losses from the week amid a pause on the recent rallies in energy prices and sovereign yields.
The Euro STOXX rose 0.5% to 6,267 and the STOXX Europe 600 rose 0.5% to 637.

Inflationary risks in the Euro Area remained rampant and the elevated levels for sovereign yields continued to dampen credit conditions, but the pause in the slump for bonds allowed equities to enjoy some respite.
Allianz, BNP Paribas, and AXA added over 1% to support the financial sector while ASML and Infineon advanced 1.3% on a strong session for AI infrastructure stocks.
The Federal Reserve was due to hike its rates by 25bps after the closing bell, and a fragmented FOMC is expected to pencil a wide range of projections for the US economy in their SEP.

title: European Stocks Close Higher
